Method.Median: Conventional median; average of the two middle values for even samples.
Method.Grouping: Sum measured per-tile elapsed values within each pass before summarizing group distributions.
Method.Scope: EarthRaster.Get through one bound delegate, including JPEG/PNG decode, linear-light resampling, palette lookup, dithering and decoded-image cache insertion/replacement. Fixture construction, delegate creation, output hashing and result allocation are excluded. Fresh EarthRaster instance per pass; static palette LUT remains warm after nine untimed passes. Sample -9 is the first cold pass, reported separately and excluded from warm summaries. No rendering or GPU submission is measured.
Method.Caveat: Native CPU tile preprocessing, not browser/FPS or GPU timing. Timing samples include native decode and SKImage creation; managed allocation counters do not capture native allocations. Cold pass retains first-call JIT/static palette costs and has only two processes per variant.

Correctness.Tests: EarthRasterChecks.Run, invoked by ImageryChecks.Run in the ordinary rendering suite.
